user_story: As a user, I want to select an option from a dropdown so that I can filter content based on my selection. Acceptance Criteria: When I visit the page at https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dropdown, I should see a dropdown element with the id 'dropdown' that contains the following options: 'Please select an option', 'Option 1', and 'Option 2'. Upon selecting 'Option 1', no URL should change, and the page should remain on the same URL. If I attempt to select the empty option, the page should also remain on the same URL.
